description: This Java class 'LiteNativePeer' interfaces with native code via JNI to load and manage a PyTorch Android module. It handles loading native libraries, initializes native peers, and provides methods to invoke module functions.

classes.name: LiteNativePeer
classes.description: JNI wrapper class for PyTorch native module, providing initialization and method invocation capabilities.
